short: Short del caso 02 ES (guion G-036 llega el 7-nov; plan plans/57-cold-case-02-historia-es.json)
momento: s 0-8 del Short, el gancho: 'Veintiocho de enero de mil novecientos ochenta y nueve. Tormenta de nieve en el monte Greyhorn. Esa noche, la dueña del hotel no llegó a la mañana.'
fuente: Caso-Archivado-La-Nieve-Recuerda ES p. 1-2: Greyhorn Lodge, monte Greyhorn, condado de Larch (oficina del sheriff), sábado 28-ene-1989, hotel de montaña, tormenta de nieve, noche de la gala del Carnaval de Invierno, dictamen 'muerte accidental'.
objetivo: Aislamiento y amenaza: un hotel de lujo atrapado en una tormenta la noche de una fiesta, y algo que quedó a medias.
estilo: Cinematic true-crime documentary re-creation set in January 1989 in the American mountain West, shot on 35mm film
lugar: Greyhorn Lodge, a large three-story 1980s timber-and-stone mountain hotel with a steep snow-covered roof and rows of tall windows, alone on a pine-covered mountainside in Larch County
luz: Night during a heavy blizzard; warm tungsten 2700K practical light from the hotel windows and a fireplace is the key light; cold blue 6000K ambient moonlight diffused by falling snow is the fill; high contrast, deep shadows, no light sources that do not exist in the scene
paleta: deep navy blue, amber window glow, desaturated white snow
lente: 35mm lens for wide shots and 85mm lens for close shots, shallow depth of field in shots 2 and 3, fine 35mm film grain, slight halation around light sources
continuidad: The same blizzard, the same night and the same hotel in all three shots; snow always falls diagonally from left to right; warm interior light versus cold exterior light in every shot

tomas.plano: extreme wide establishing shot from a high angle
tomas.camara: slow descending crane move toward the hotel
tomas.sujeto: the whole Greyhorn Lodge with every window glowing amber
tomas.accion: sits alone on the mountainside while thick snow sweeps across the frame and the pine trees bend in the wind

tomas.plano: medium shot inside the hotel's empty grand hall
tomas.camara: slow lateral dolly from left to right at table height
tomas.sujeto: a long banquet table after a Winter Carnival gala, with half-empty champagne glasses, burned-down candles, paper party streamers and scattered confetti
tomas.accion: candle flames flicker in a draft while snow hits the tall windows behind the table
tomas.foco: shallow focus on the champagne glasses, the windows soft behind
tomas.luz: amber firelight from a large stone fireplace off screen right, candles as practicals

tomas.plano: close-up insert from outside the hotel
tomas.sujeto: a single frosted upstairs window of the hotel at night
tomas.accion: thick falling snow drifts past the window ledge in real time while the warm light behind the glass flickers once
tomas.foco: sharp focus on the frosted window, snowflakes in the foreground softly blurred

audio: Ambient only: howling blizzard wind, creaking timber, faint crackle of a fireplace in shot 2. No music, no dialogue, no voices, no extra sound effects.
evitar: no people or human figures anywhere
no on-screen text, signs or readable words
no modern objects, cars, phones or LED lights
no extra shots or transitions beyond the three described
notas: Revisión 1 (2026-11-06): 'snow piles up' en 2,5 s era imposible sin time-lapse -> cambiado a nieve que cae en tiempo real; sujeto y acción se pegaban sin puntuación -> arreglado en gemini.py (Subject:/Action:). Revisión 2: rack focus + doble parpadeo en 2,5 s era demasiado -> foco fijo y un parpadeo; 'paper snowflake decorations' arriesga adornos navideños -> serpentinas y confeti.
resultado: USABLE (2026-11-06, US$0.56, 48 s): 3 tomas con cortes en 2,5 s y 5,5 s como se pidió. Toma 1 hotel en ventisca, toma 2 mesa de gala con copas y velas, toma 3 ventana escarchada. Defecto: la toma 1 trae esquinas redondeadas (borde de película) -> en Remotion escalar 104%. La escarcha de la toma 3 parece copos recortados; aceptable.
